sourceNotes.rawContent:
Elevate your style with this Vintage Anti-Tarnish Gold Bracelet Watch, featuring a rich emerald green dial, classic minimal detailing, and a sleek flexible gold-tone mesh bracelet strap. The deep green dial beautifully contrasts with the polished golden cross-bezel finish, creating a sophisticated vintage-inspired look.
Its slim round dial and elegant textured mesh bracelet give it a refined, jewellery-like appearance, making it perfect for women who prefer a classic yet stylish timepiece. Easy to pair with both ethnic and western outfits, this watch adds a graceful touch to any look.
Product Highlights
✨ Vintage-inspired bracelet watch
💛 Anti-tarnish gold-tone finish
💚 Elegant deep emerald green dial
🕰️ Minimalist gold hour markers & hands
🔗 Sleek flexible mesh bracelet strap
⌚ Quartz movement
💎 Jewellery-inspired elegant cross-bezel design
👗 Perfect for ethnic and western outfits
🎁 Ideal gifting option for women
✨ Suitable for everyday wear and special occasions
Perfect For
Office wear, college, casual outings, festive occasions, parties, date nights, weddings, and gifting.
Care Tip: Keep away from perfumes, water, excessive sweat, and harsh chemicals. Store in a dry place when not in use to help maintain the finish.
